title: Tube Bender Die Compatibility: What Fits What, Brand by Brand
excerpt: Tube bender die compatibility, brand by brand: which dies makers say fit, which don't, pin sizes, and why cross-brand fit stays unknown until confirmed.

notes: No cross-brand die fit is claimed anywhere: every cross-brand cell says 'Unknown, ask the maker'. An Eastwood Q&A answer claims Eastwood HC dies fit the WFB2; deliberately NOT repeated (owner claim, not maker/retailer). Research was via web-search result summaries; maker sites could not be opened directly from this environment, so please spot-check: JD2 FAQ wording (only Model 3 dies in Model 4; Model 1 uses Model 4 dies, Model 2 uses Model 3 dies), JD2 Model 32 1-1/4 in pins vs Model 3 7/8 in pins, Rogue FAQ pin sizes (7/8 in for 2023+, 3/4 in earlier) and 'pressure die capacity should match model'. Baileigh RDB-050 die wall figures are the wall each set's CLR is 'based on', not stated limits. The WFBDT2X6 die's bend angle is not stated (Woodward sells 120 and 180 degree families). New ASINs B07PQMRB5K and B07PQMV4RC were seen in a WebSearch restricted to amazon.com with matching titles.
